import csv
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import report

# Independent recomputation with a different mechanism.
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('events.csv',encoding='utf-8',newline='')))
tot=timedelta()
for r in rows:
    a=datetime.strptime(r['started_at'].strip(),'%H:%M:%S')
    b=datetime.strptime(r['ended_at'].strip(),'%H:%M:%S')
    if b<a: b+=timedelta(days=1)
    tot+=b-a
ref=int(tot.total_seconds())//60
got=report.total_minutes()
print('report.total_minutes() =',got, type(got).__name__)
print('independent check      =',ref)
print('MATCH' if got==ref else 'MISMATCH')
print('naive no-wrap variant  =',sum(int((datetime.strptime(r['ended_at'].strip(),'%H:%M:%S')-datetime.strptime(r['started_at'].strip(),'%H:%M:%S')).total_seconds()) for r in rows)//60)
print('worker_ids() still ok  =',report.worker_ids())

python3 -c "
import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import report

rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('events.csv',encoding='utf-8',newline='')))
acc=defaultdict(timedelta)
for r in rows:
    w=r['worker'].strip()
    if not w: continue
    a=datetime.strptime(r['started_at'].strip(),'%H:%M:%S')
    b=datetime.strptime(r['ended_at'].strip(),'%H:%M:%S')
    if b<a: b+=timedelta(days=1)
    acc[w]+=b-a
ref={w:int(v.total_seconds())//60 for w,v in sorted(acc.items())}

got=report.by_worker()
print('by_worker() ==independent check:',got==ref)
print('keys == worker_ids()          :',list(got)==report.worker_ids())
print('keys sorted                   :',list(got)==sorted(got))
print('all values int                :',all(isinstance(v,int) for v in got.values()))
print()
for w,m in got.items():
    print('  ',w,str(m).rjust(5),'min  =',str(round(m/60,1)).rjust(5),'hr')
print()
print('sum(by_worker().values()) =',sum(got.values()))
print('total_minutes()           =',report.total_minutes())
print('gap from per-worker floor =',report.total_minutes()-sum(got.values()),'min')
"
